name: listing.isIgnored
title: Field: listing.isIgnored
description: Meaning and invariants of the buyer-visible listing.isIgnored field.
meaning: True when the current authenticated actor has ignored the listing.

invariants.label: Actor relative
invariants.value: Ignore state belongs to the current actor.

invariants.label: Not global
invariants.value: Does not mean the listing is hidden for everyone.

text:
# listing.isIgnored

TL;DR:
- listing.isIgnored tells you whether the current actor has ignored this listing.

What it means:
- It is actor-relative and affects the current buyer view, not global listing state.

Agent hint:
- Use it carefully when explaining why something appears only after including ignored items.
